text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...! Phew~... phew~...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ......Isn't that fine~?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Ain't I looking totally fab!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Espoir City's running still has a lot of 
rough edges.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Still, the moment she gave that subtle 
fist pump, I found myself clenching my own 
fist along with her."
choice_data_list: (I did it...!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! Did ya see that? Did ya see 
how amazing I was?!
choice_data_list:
I saw that! You're definitely going to get 
even stronger!

I saw that! You're definitely going to get 
even stronger!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Heh... Well duh, moron.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I'm strong, damn it! Now that you get it, 
enter me in tons of races, alright?! I'm 
gonna rack up win after win!"
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's enter more and more races!

Yeah, let's keep entering more and more 
races!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I pull out the "textbook" and write down 
what I learned today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Future Policy: To help her focus on 
training, provide an environment away from 
the eyes of others."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From now on, I can enter races with full 
confidence. After all, my worries about 
training are completely gone.
choice_data_list:
(—If I can just arrange for us to be 
alone!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And a few days later.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Train during lunchtime?
choice_data_list:
Looks like we're going to get some quality 
training in.

Looks like we can get some quality 
training in.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the Umamusume's schedule, there is a 
one-hour lunch break following the morning 
classes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And after taking one more class in the 
afternoon, she's supposed to begin 
training with her Trainer, but..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During lunch break, most Umamusume head to 
the cafeteria to eat, leaving the track 
relatively empty.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not only was it outside normal training 
hours, but it was also a time of day far 
more deserted than early morning or 
evening.
choice_data_list: (If we could train there...!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Are you an idiot, you bastard?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
What about my lunch?! What're you gonna do 
about it?!
choice_data_list: Of course I'll cover for you!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...A boxed lunch made by *you*?
choice_data_list:
Yep! And I'll prepare some light snacks 
too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For light snacks, I plan to prepare things 
that won't be hard on the stomach even if 
eaten before training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, that won't be enough for an 
Umamusume in her growth spurt. 
Therefore...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I will take about an hour of the afternoon 
training left to the Trainer's discretion 
and replace it with lunch time.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Pfft.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ah ha ha! *You're* bringing a bento...? Ah 
ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Are you seriously gonna make my lunch 
every single morning from now on!?
choice_data_list: ...I'll keep nutrition in mind too!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ha...! Don't you dare slack off, or you'll 
answer to me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, without delay, I reserved a track 
during the lunch break hour where "nobody 
else had booked."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, for real, barely anyone's here. 
Haha...!
choice_data_list: We're starting with start practice today.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? The start...? Why start with basics 
like that...
choice_data_list: A true pro Umamusume never neglects that.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ! A professional's...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her opponents in this Debut race, just 
like Espoir City, were all Umamusume 
running their 'first race ever.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, this is a one-time condition. In 
their next race, some will be running 
their "second race" like her, while 
others—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—There's even a chance we might face an 
Umamusume who has already won two or more 
races.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I see... Our next opponents will be even 
stronger...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Without getting distracted by anything 
else, she carefully turns over my words in 
her mind."
choice_data_list:
(The environment really is crucial for 
her.)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...I'll do it...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Let's do this, dammit! We're going all 
out, ya bastards!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her display such motivation, I 
nodded firmly and began explaining the 
details of the menu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And the "environment free of other 
people" that I arranged for her didn't end 
with just the lunch break.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the VR Umalator! We're using this 
too?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For example, Tracen Academy's specialized 
facility, the "VR Umalator." If we make 
use of this virtual reality exercise 
system...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Recreating an "empty racecourse" is a 
piece of cake for her too.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ooooooh! You've got the whole track to 
yourself!
choice_data_list:
Today we're going to build up your leg 
power!
Today we'll work on your leg power!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Foot power?
choice_data_list:
Let's accelerate with your upper body 
upright on purpose!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“Running in a posture that intentionally 
makes acceleration difficult in order to 
build kicking power.” That is how I 
explain it to Espoir City.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Daaaaahhh!!
choice_data_list: That's the spirit! Espo!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Shut uuuuup! Just this once, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...And then. Besides that..."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Rent out this entire stadium...?
choice_data_list:
Huh, I'm surprised they actually let you 
borrow it.

Huh, I'm surprised they actually let you 
borrow it, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After asking senior Trainers and Umamusume 
about facilities available for just the 
two of us, I managed to gather some useful 
information.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Above all, the advice from the model Gold 
City was spot on, as she told me about a 
special spot where one could train with no 
one else around.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ha... haha...! This feels kinda 
luxurious...!
choice_data_list:
We don't have much time, but let's do our 
best!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, dammit! If we're out of time, 
lock in and focus, dammit!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Uraaaaaaaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And as if the days before her debut were a 
dream, she began making rapid strides in 
her ability.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Her environment really is crucial to her 
after all. I'll continue using this method 
going forward...!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Takin' notes again, are ya? Right there 
in your damn 'textbook'.
choice_data_list: I've made another new discovery.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Well, make sure to study up! After all, 
I've made my debut now.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: And then...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"And from now on... I'll be going up 
against girls who are stronger than in my 
debut race..."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Match after match is being decided...
choice_data_list:
Oh, are you looking forward to the next 
race too, Espo?

Ah, are you looking forward to the next 
race too, Espo?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh!? O-Of course I do!?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hurry up and enter me in a race, dammit! 
I'm gonna kick serious ass!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: 'Cause I'm a strong horse girl!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm expecting great things!
Yeah, I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Espoir City also seemed to be getting even 
more pumped up for her next race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Let's continue training like this for a 
while, entering various races to help her 
grow stronger!
